description: Neuralese direct v1 (owner 2026-10-11; plans/neuralese/NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md): plain whole-trajectory target SFT of a base model on the native records, one pass on ordinary token embeddings (no input map, no second pass, no self-distillation), the NeuraleseProjection producing the Neuralese value (soft-token mixture plus a zero-initialised causal conv correction, trained on detached states), the TokenChoiceProjection declared off. Windows hold the whole preceding document (system prompt included); routers and norms on AdamW, attention and expert matrices on the latent optimizer. Shared by both lines; backbone-inherent differences in neuralese-direct-mellum-v1 / -lfm-v1.
